verdict.summary: All four reports truthfully say delivery=incomplete, and all four have at least one real gap (G16 is absent in every artifact). However the artifacts are unsafe: G15 deletions gutted the sales-service-fee payment clause without the required G16 replacement; D11 G18 summary p1207 is a hidden obligation-level false complete; D02 audit falsely marks G12/G13 completed; D16 G17 is only half-applied (summary deleted, body retained); D01 G01 is missing and G17 was dropped by a false overlap. Several incompletes (G06 all; D01 G02; D11 G05:2) are false blocks, not real defects. Gate must remain FAIL/BLOCK until the real gaps and the proof model are fixed.

findings.recommendation: Implement G16 in body and summary copies for all four, including daily accrual, direct-sales return on redemption/termination, other-agency monthly payment, and >1-year return. Do not apply G15 without G16.

findings.claim: G15 delete the certified old payment clause.
findings.actual: The deleted paragraphs are contract-specific variants (5 working days, auto-debit, 划出/代收, 注册登记机构代收), not the literal G15 old_text (10 working days, instruction-based). The deletion matches G15's intent but not its exact old_text; with G16 missing it is a net content loss.
findings.business_impact: Authorization scope is broader than the literal rule; the deletion is only defensible as part of a G15+G16 replacement. Currently G16 is missing.
findings.recommendation: Treat these as G15 variants only when the paired G16 append is applied; otherwise flag for manual review instead of deleting.

findings.business_impact: Latent false-block risk for any multi-class fund where G02 is audited.
findings.recommendation: Apply class substitution to obligation new_text and audit prompts; never audit against template placeholder classes.
